features_info.title: Batteries and Controls Are Not Enabled Yet
features_info.description:
By default, only officially documented SolarEdge features are enabled: inverters, synergy inverters, and meters.

Battery monitoring and all read/write control features (battery control, site limit control) are based on documentation that SolarEdge does not publish. These are disabled by default and must be turned on separately from the integration's Configure options after this hub is added.

Not all inverters support these over Modbus. You may need to contact SolarEdge support to have battery and control access exposed on your installation.

data_description.scan_interval: How often, in seconds, to read data from the inverters.
data_description.close_after_polling: Close the Modbus/TCP connection after each successful poll. Enable this if something else also connects to the inverter, because it accepts only one connection at a time.
data_description.detect_meters: Look for meters connected to each inverter when the integration starts.
data_description.detect_batteries: Look for batteries connected to each inverter when the integration starts. Battery support uses registers that SolarEdge does not officially document.
data_description.detect_extras: Check whether each inverter supports Global Dynamic Power Control and Advanced Power Control, and add their entities when found.
data_description.virtual_system: Add a System device with power sensors calculated from your inverters and meters, such as solar generation and consumption. The sensors of your other devices are not changed. On by default when there is more than one inverter.
data_description.advanced_power_control: Show the Power Control Options step next, to turn storage control and site limit control on or off.
data_description.request_timeout: How long, in seconds, to wait for a reply to each Modbus request.
data_description.sleep_after_write: Seconds to wait between requests to an inverter after a command is written to it. Some inverters need time to process a command before they reply again. 0 turns this off.

adv_pwr_ctl.title: Power Control Options

data_description.adv_storage_control: Add entities that change battery storage control settings on the inverter.
data_description.adv_site_limit_control: Add entities that change the site export and production limit settings on the inverter.

adv_pwr_ctl.description: Warning: These options can violate utility agreements, alter your utility billing, may require special equipment, and overwrite provisioning by SolarEdge or your installer. Use at your own risk! Adjustable parameters in Modbus registers are intended for long-term storage. Periodic changes may damage the flash memory.

data.battery_energy_reset_cycles: Update Cycles to Reset Battery Energy

data_description.allow_battery_energy_reset: Some batteries report energy totals that go down or reset to zero. When off, a lower value is ignored and the last value is kept. When on, the lower value is accepted.
data_description.battery_energy_reset_cycles: Number of polls in a row that a lower battery energy value must be seen before it is accepted. Only used when Allow Battery Energy to Reset is on.
data_description.battery_rating_adjust: Percent above the battery's rated energy that its available energy may reach before the value is treated as invalid. Use this if your battery reports more than its rating.

setup_inverter_id_failed.title: Invalid Inverter Device ID
setup_inverter_id_failed.description: Inverter Device ID {device_id} at {host} is not responding or is not a valid SolarEdge inverter. It has been skipped. If the device was replaced or its ID changed, update the Inverter Device ID List in the hub configuration. Otherwise check the device and Modbus/TCP connection.

confirm.title: Global Dynamic Power Control Timeout
confirm.description:
Inverter Device ID {device_id} at {host} did not respond while reading data for Global Dynamic Power Controls after several attempts. These entities are unavailable until this is resolved.

Confirm to try detecting this feature again on the next poll. Disable the Auto-Detect Additional Entities option if the inverter has trouble trying to read these sensors.
